contract.canonicalization: UTF8 compact JSON with recursively sorted object keys and ensure_ascii=false; descriptors contain strings, integers, booleans and string arrays only
contract.document_sha256_allowlist: Exact admitted office-document hashes are reserved to office provenance mode and cannot omit it to fall through native-print mode
contract.duplicate_policy: Unique admitted PDF byte hash per descriptor; repeated original source occurrences remain in the private occurrence manifest; no preferred financial copy is selected
contract.identity_authority_limit: Continuity to preserved original tax-source records only. Scanned raster evidence manually reviewed; no OCR, government identity verification, legal name change, native generation, as-filed status, full-return completeness or financial approval is established.
contract.identity_qualification: Visual source review matched normalized full taxpayer names and original-source taxpayer identifier continuity; raw name-byte equality remains unverified.
contract.mixed_owner_year_review_sha256_semantics: Hash of actual ordered four-page raster/header/official-year/printed-page1-4 evidence, independently re-rendered against original PDF bytes and visually reviewed twice. No OCR or zero-regex-hit owner inference.
contract.owner_year_evidence_sha256_semantics: Hash of complete canonical document-specific evidence binding both exact private source reports, their structured evidence with source paths represented by hashes, original same-year Info1 proof and normalized full-name support. Raw name-byte equality is not asserted.
contract.owner_year_requirement: Two independent visual reviews of actual taxpayer first/last cells and official2018 T1 banner, all four printed pages1-4 and identical labeled owner/header/SIN continuity. Entire names match the exact same-year original archived identity after Unicode alphanumeric/casefold formatting normalization only; raw name-byte equality is not asserted. Full unmasked taxpayer SIN and explicitly labeled Year-Month-Day DOB match one unique original client across source years and exactly one SAME-year/client/family original Info1 context. All12 matching Info1 DCL/CRC/native-type/declared-length/EXF-EXY-EXC anchors are independently verified. All raster evidence is tied to exact unmodified original PDF bytes, not filename/parent-folder identity or an assumed text layer.
contract.page_count: Derived from ordered generic page_labels; original PDF bytes and page order never change
contract.profile_sha256_semantics: SHA256 of this canonical contract, not the closed profile file; full canonical descriptors are separately allowlisted
contract.source_and_financial_policy: Preserve scanned PDF bytes and existing client IDs/profiles/figure versions. No OCR, PDF changes, new tax calculation, preferred financial version, government identity claim, raw name-byte equality claim, filed-copy assertion, complete-return assertion or approved figure is created. This scan is a distinct contract from frozen177 and stable2.
contract.source_manifest_sha256_semantics: Hash of the frozen one-record scanned-document source-review closed profile binding both exact independently reviewed source reports, normalized-name support, original same-year Info1/context proof and original-source/static-integrity supplement. Not an API staging manifest.
contract.source_metadata_sha256_semantics: Hash of a separate source Creator/Producer metadata and original byte/stat evidence artifact; software generation is not inferred
contract.source_occurrence_manifest_sha256_semant: Hash of a separate immutable source-occurrence manifest identifying the original source by its preserved preparation-manifest hash and record ordinal, full original path hash, source byte hash/size/date, preserved original report hashes and independent source-integrity evidence; no taxpayer names or raw identifiers propagate into structured metadata.
contract.static_pdf_review_sha256_semantics: Hash of a separate document-specific static PDF review artifact recording byte hash, page count and bounded object/action checks
